name: Influenza Drops
dosage:
Take 10-15 drops in some water every 15 minutes to 2 hours.

Safety Information

It is best avoided in pregnancy, lactation and children
Read the label carefully before use
Store in a cool and dry place, away from sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
Don't exceed the recommended dosage
Use under medical supervision
Avoid any strong smell in the mouth, such as coffee, onion, hing, mint, camphor,
side_effects: No known side effects when taken as directed.
